messages.subject: Re: [Rqtl-disc] qtx file to qtl warning with chromosome length

I would use write.cross to save it to a file (I'd use "csv" format).

karl

On Oct 16, 2012, at 2:46 AM, Eiram <eiram...@gmail.com> wrote:

Dear Dr Broman
 
I am new to Rqtl and have opened a qtx file using the following command;
 
data <- read.cross("qtx", ".", "2Gy.qtx") after placing the file in the library.
 
To which there is this 'Warning message';

In summary.cross(data) :
  Some chromosomes > 1000 cM in length; there may be a problem with the genetic map.
  (Perhaps it is in basepairs?)
 
I am sure this is not in basepairs (according to qtx software).  However, upon opening and closing the map view using the QTX program encounters a problem and the software is forced to shutdown.  It seems to be something with the qtx software as I have opened the listeria.qtx file in QTX and same shut down occurs with open/close of map view.  
 
Is there a way I can investigate or edit the genetic map distances.with Rqtl as QTX isn't very flexible?
 
Best wishes,
 
Eiram
